name: Esteria Bahamut
original_name: エステリア・バハムート
source:
She is the Divine Beast Bahamut who watches over and protects the people of Granleyd, in human form. As a living divine being, she commands great respect and support from the citizens of the empire. Contained within her body is a boundless amount of Esprit, and she exists in a domain beyond mortal beings. She is widely considered the single strongest being in existence in the current time.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
